lanes.summary:
Diff e7a52949d...HEAD for PMAT-2730 (#2730) fully satisfies all ticket acceptance criteria without refutation:

1. Defect & Root Cause: Previously, an empty brick set evaluated `brick_scores.iter().all(...)`, which vacuously returned `true`, reporting `status: "PASS"` and `ci_result: "green"` despite a grade F and 0/0 falsification points. Consequently, `apr cbtop --ci` with default thresholds exited 0.
2. Shared Helper (`crates/apr-cli/src/commands/cbtop_get_cpu_memory.rs`): Introduced `brick_verdict`, which treats an empty brick set as `all_pass: false`, `total: 1`, `passed: 0`, `failed: 1`. For non-empty sets, it maintains the existing `1.0 + 1e-9` gap factor epsilon rule.
3. Dual Producers Unified: Both `generate_headless_report_simulated` (`cbtop_get_cpu_memory.rs`) and CUDA-gated `build_and_output_report` (`cbtop_measure_batch.rs`) now share `brick_verdict`, preventing producer divergence.
4. CI Gate Verified: `test_empty_brick_report_is_red_and_fails_ci` verifies that `--ci` fails on empty brick sets without needing explicit throughput/score thresholds.
5. Defect Inversion: `test_headless_report_simulated_no_bricks` in `cbtop_falsification_summary_hardware.rs` had previously asserted the defect (`"PASS"`); this was updated to assert `"FAIL"` and `"red"`.
6. Receipt Claims & Mutation: All 7 claims in `docs/audits/impl-PMAT-2730-receipt.md` are backed by the diff. Restoring the vacuous `.all()` turns 3 tests RED. No gates were weakened, and no out-of-scope code was included.

The diff completely and correctly satisfies ticket PMAT-2730 (#2730). It replaces the vacuous `.all()` check across both simulated and measured cbtop report producers with a shared `brick_verdict` helper function. Zero-brick reports are now assigned `total: 1, passed: 0, failed: 1, status: FAIL, ci_result: red`, causing `--ci` to fail as required without explicit thresholds. Non-empty brick sets retain identical epsilon-tolerant evaluation semantics. All receipt claims are backed by the diff. Verdict: PASS.
